model_annotation: This pie chart, titled "儿童长新闻数量" (Children's Long News Quantity), represents the distribution of children's long-form news articles across eight categories. The chart contains eight slices, each labeled with a percentage value displayed inside the slice. The largest slice represents 科学 (Science) in dark navy blue at 21%, followed closely by 社会 (Society) in orange at 20%, and 榜样 (Role Models) in golden yellow at 19%. Two categories share the same proportion of 14%: 文化 (Culture) in dark blue-gray and 环境保护 (Environmental Protection) in light brown/tan. 政治 (Politics) appears in light green at 6%, 体育 (Sports) in blue at 4%, and 经济 (Economy) in red at 2%, making it the smallest slice. A legend is provided at the bottom of the chart, displaying all eight categories with their corresponding color indicators. The percentage labels are displayed in white text within each slice. The slices do not appear to be arranged in strictly descending order by size, and none of the slices are visually exploded or offset from the center.
